rubric.role_summary: Director-level music editorial and curation role establishing editorial vision, curation frameworks, and music-discovery programs, while building a team and partnering with Product and Engineering.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Director-level music editorial and curation role establishing editorial vision, curation frameworks, and music-discovery programs, while building a team and partnering with Product and Engineering.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in A&R, editorial, or a related field within the music industry.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a streaming, publication, or AI company.
- Familiarity specifically with music taxonomy or editorial curation systems.
- Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams.
- Experience building and improving processes across marketing or editorial workflows.
- Familiarity with metadata and taxonomy systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
